properties.label: Centred semicircular instrument
properties.text: Centre a calibrated semicircular instrument on a fine dark engineering grid, placing a large numeric reading inside the arc with a small unit label and compact secondary readout row.

properties.label: Tabular HUD readout
properties.text: Use tabular monospace for the main value, unit and secondary readings.

properties.label: Black-green and amber scale
properties.text: Use black-green #040607, warm amber #ffb43c and dim machined gray.

properties.label: Ranked calibrated gauge
properties.text: Build thick and thin tick ranks, an inner hairline arc and an exact lit-segment endpoint around the named scale.

properties.label: Concentrated amber glow
properties.text: Concentrate the amber glow around lit evidence while preserving a dark core inside the light.

properties.label: Single-source gauge value
properties.text: Generate the lit tick count, displayed value and accessible description from one explicitly named quantity and scale.

properties.label: No decorative telemetry
properties.text: Do not present decorative values as live telemetry.

properties.label: Calibrated-object acceptance
properties.text: Reconcile the meter scale, retain legibility of tiny labels and verify that the result reads as a calibrated object rather than a number inside a ring.
